item.title: Newcastle win at Spurs to pile pressure on Frank
item.description: Jacob Ramsey fired Newcastle United to a precious 2-1 Premier League win to pile the pressure on Thomas Frank and increase Tottenham Hotspur 's relegation fears.

item.title: Australia's Toure hits hat trick in Norwich debut
item.description: Socceroos striker Mohamed Toure has made a remarkable starting debut for Norwich, scoring a hat trick as the Canaries hammered Oxford United 3-0 in the Championship.
